messages:
Maria (CS): Heads up — Aurora Labs ramp test hitting 429s during onboarding. They spin up ~180 parallel preflight requests from browser clients and after ~25-35s start seeing `preflight_quota` 429s. SDK: browser-js v1.4.2, using ephemeral tokens via /auth/refresh.

Ingrid (Eng): Do we have logs or sample error payloads? Which endpoints are most impacted?

Maria (CS): Sample: `HTTP 429 {"error":"rate_limited","reason":"preflight_quota"}`. Mostly /v1/embeddings; small percentage to /v1/streams. They open multiple tabs during QA (10 workers x ~18 tabs).

Sam (DevEx): Common pattern: each tab performs its own refresh call on mount, minting independent ephemeral tokens. That multiplies token count and hits per-token limits. Recommend adding client-side debounce or shared session token.

Devon (CS): Customer says "works on my laptop" but fails during concurrent QA. Sounds like token-per-tab amplification.

Ingrid (Eng): @TelemetryBot pull traces for tokens with prefix `aurora-` between 1782359900 and 1782360200 and summarize top error causes.

TelemetryBot: Traces pulled. Peak at 1782359992: ~230 requests in 12s tied to the same org, many using distinct ephemeral tokens. Top error: 429 preflight_quota on embeddings. Links: https://internal/trace/aurora/def456 (internal).

Sam (DevEx): Actionable client fix: ensure only one in-flight `/auth/refresh` per browser session. Provide example debounce/snippet in onboarding docs. Also check they reuse `x-client-id` header per session instead of new per tab.

Maria (CS): They shared their auth code: `window.addEventListener('load', ()=> fetch('/auth/refresh'))` on each tab. So yep — new token on every tab.

Devon (CS): Short-term mitigation: ask to gate refresh so a single token is reused across tabs, or server-side exchange to return same token for session. I'll send steps. Long-term: add a token proxy example to Quickstart.

Ingrid (Eng): We can also lift their per-token preflight limit briefly. If you want, I can grant org_aurora_42 a 72-hour embedding concurrency bump to 300 while they deploy the fix. We'll track with INF-7123.

Maria (CS): Please go ahead with the temporary bump for embeddings only. I'll push the debounce snippet and request a deploy.

Ingrid (Eng): Done. Exception created: INF-7123, expires in 72h, embeddings concurrency raised to 300. Recorded config change.

Sam (DevEx): Debounce example added to docs: ```js
let refreshPromise = null
function sessionToken(){
  if(refreshPromise) return refreshPromise
  refreshPromise = fetch('/auth/refresh').then(r=> r.json()).finally(()=> refreshPromise = null)
  return refreshPromise
}
```

Devon (CS): Patch sent to Aurora. Monitoring for reduced 429s. If flapping persists after the patch, we'll escalate and consider renewal risk flag.

Maria (CS): Thanks — I'll update the onboarding ticket with INF-7123 and the client snippet. Follow-up check-in in 24h. :thumbsup:
